evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/e/c carries plugin name 'GPU Mode', group 'gpu', description 'Enhance the graphics and performance of the game' and gpu_icon.png.
The plugin owns GpuRenderer/OpenCL-related startup, config-change and synchronization behavior and registers the already-reviewed GpuPluginPanel.
RuneLite source class GpuPlugin owns the same GPU renderer/config lifecycle, shader recompilation, scaling/colorblind mode changes and GPU synchronization concerns.

proposals.note: Source-proven RuneLite GpuPlugin identity with SpawnPK descriptor text retained as exact authority.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/e/e preserves NEAREST, LINEAR, MITCHELL, CATMULL_ROM and XBR together with display names Nearest Neighbor, Bilinear, Bicubic (Mitchell), Bicubic (Catmull-Rom) and xBR.
RuneLite GPU source/API exposes enum UIScalingMode with the same named scaling algorithms; later source adds HYBRID but preserves these exact constants.
GpuPluginConfig uses this enum directly for its UI scaling mode setting.

proposals.note: Source-identical RuneLite GPU UI scaling enum for the v308 constant set.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 enum rs/s/e/a preserves NONE, PROTANOPE, DEUTERANOPE and TRITANOPE.
RuneLite GPU config source exposes enum ColorBlindMode with the identical four constants.
rs/s/e/d returns this enum from the GPU colorblindness-correction config option.

Exact v308 rs/s/e/d is the gpu config interface and exposes enabled, anti-aliasing, anisotropic filtering, stretched mode, aspect ratio, UI scaling, colorblind correction, smooth banding and Vsync controls.
RuneLite source/API names the GPU configuration interface GpuPluginConfig and preserves matching anti-aliasing, anisotropic filtering, UI scaling and colorblind controls.
rs/s/e/c consumes this interface as its injected GPU configuration and reacts to its vsyncMode and rendering settings.
